title: PDFtract Baseline Metrics Schema
description: Schema for baseline benchmark metrics stored in benches/baselines/

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA (short or full) for the pdftract version used

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the baseline was recorded

pdftract_geomean.description: Geometric mean extraction time in seconds across all fixtures for pdftract

pdfminer_geomean.description: Geometric mean extraction time in seconds across all fixtures for pdfminer.six

pypdf_geomean.description: Geometric mean extraction time in seconds across all fixtures for pypdf

pdfplumber_geomean.description: Geometric mean extraction time in seconds across all fixtures for pdfplumber

grep_1000_mean_ms.description: Mean time in milliseconds for searching across 1000-PDF corpus

throughput_mb_per_sec.description: Aggregate throughput in megabytes per second for grep-corpus benchmark

files_per_sec.description: Files processed per second in grep-corpus benchmark

total_runtime_sec.description: Total wall-clock runtime in seconds for the complete benchmark suite

corpus_size.description: Number of PDF files in the test corpus

notes.description: Free-form notes about this baseline (e.g., placeholder, experimental, environmental factors)
